description: NaTiSn(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.01 Å) and three longer (2.05 Å) Sn-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom.
